mechanism_narrative: Increasing GDPC1 indicates strong economic demand, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth is positive but SPX returns are negative over 60 days in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE below 5% signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns in 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE remains below 5% but SPX returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising FEDFUNDS with low UNRATE indicates tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns in 20 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases and UNRATE is low
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises with low UNRATE but SPX returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening, higher FEDFUNDS leads to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS increases but SPX returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising CPIAUCSL indicates inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns in 20 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL increases but SPX returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO growth above 5% signals strong supply, leading to positive S&P 500 returns in 60 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth exceeds 5% but SPX returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing PAYEMS and RSAFS indicates strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns in 20 days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS and RSAFS increase but SPX returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During expansion, increasing HOUST boosts S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: HOUST increases but SPX returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.
